# Remotion documentation

> Remotion is a React framework for creating videos programmatically.

This is a guide to the main documentation topics. Fetch the linked Markdown pages for details and follow their links to more specific guides and APIs.

## Getting started

- [Creating a new project](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/index.md)
- [The core idea](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/idea.md)
- [API overview](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/api.md)

## Creating videos

- [Animating properties](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/animating-properties.md)
- [Video and Audio](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/video-and-audio.md)
- [Adding video and audio](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/videos/index.md)
- [@remotion/media](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/media/index.md)
- [Using fonts](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/fonts.md)
- [@remotion/transitions](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/transitions/index.md)
- [Captions](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/captions/index.md)
- [Effects](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/effects.md)
- [@remotion/shapes](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/shapes/index.md)

## Elements

- [Remotion Elements](https://www.remotion.dev/elements/index.md): Editable video building blocks. Each Element's Markdown includes its install command and source code.
- [More Elements](https://www.remotion.dev/elements/libraries.md): Third-party Element Libraries and their Markdown indexes. To install an Element from a page that embeds its payload, run `npx remotion elements use <url> --composition <composition-id> --yes`.
- [Building Element Libraries](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/elements/libraries.md)
